images.title: On either side of one
images.purpose: Show 3/5 to the left of 1 and 10/9 to the right of 1 on one number line, so 1 acts as a signpost and 3/5 < 10/9.
images.composition: A number line from 0 to 2 with 1 marked as the tall signpost tick, two dots above it with their fractions, two arrows below saying less than 1 and more than 1, and the comparison at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Plain white frame, 1456 by 816. One thin dark #2B2B2B horizontal number line at y 330 from x 188 to x 1268, with exactly 3 vertical ticks at x 228, 728 and 1228 (positions 0, 1 and 2, 500 px for each whole). The ticks at 0 and 2 are 50 px tall; the tick at 1 is taller (70 px) and reddish purple #CC79A7. Under the ticks the labels 0, 1 and 2 (44 px, bold, dark #1F2937, about y 400). Exactly 2 dots (30 px across) on the line: a teal #0072B2 dot at x 528 (the position of 3/5) and an amber #E69F00 dot at x 784 (the position of 10/9, just right of the tick at 1). Above each dot its fraction in bold dark numerals (60 px, about y 230): 3/5 above the teal dot and 10/9 above the amber dot. Under the line, about y 470, 2 straight arrows 6 px thick with arrowheads: a teal arrow from x 718 to x 238 pointing left with the text less than 1 centred at x 478 under it (40 px, about y 520), and an amber arrow from x 738 to x 1218 pointing right with the text more than 1 centred at x 978 under it (40 px, about y 520). Across the bottom centre, about y 700, one line of bold dark text, 3/5 < 10/9 (80 px), the largest text in the frame. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
3/5 drawn to the right of 1 or 10/9 to the left of 1
any tick or label other than 0, 1 and 2
images.takeaway: 3/5 is less than 1 and 10/9 is more than 1, so 3/5 < 10/9.
images.description: A number line from 0 to 2 with 3/5 marked left of 1 and 10/9 marked right of 1, arrows saying less than 1 and more than 1, and 3/5 < 10/9 written below.
images.context: Concept image for Compare with 1. It follows the idea of the figure in your maths book (a fraction placed on a number line with 1 as the reference) and shows the concept's own example, 3/5 and 10/9.
images.teaching_notes: Use 1 as a signpost: ask which side of 1 each fraction sits on before comparing anything else. The slip to watch is deciding by the top numbers alone, which would say 10/9 is more only because 10 is big.

image_decisions.why: A number line with 3/5 left of 1 and 10/9 right of 1 is the whole reasoning of comparing with the reference 1.
